intro.description: Collection of 100% natural Crystal Quartz Bracelets made from a variety of fascinating bead shapes of the gemstone. The Bracelets are strung in Thread, or in Silver with or without Gold polish. Crystal Quartz heals and balances the Sahasrara/Crown Chakra, which expands consciousness and awareness, augments spiritual growth, brings clarity of thoughts, improves memory, helps to connection with Divine realm. Crystal stone calms down the mind, clears the aura, aids in meditation and is endowed with several other healing properties.
